---

Procurement is programmed, not assumed. Every package below is tied to an activity
in the master programme, and every package is required **before** the activity that
installs it. The dates are computed from the programme, not typed in.

The governing fact of this project's procurement is that **the blast door cast-in
frames must be welded into the W6 and W7 reinforcement cages before those walls are
poured.** That single dependency puts a vendor lead time on the critical path chain
from day one and is why the blast door enquiry is the first procurement activity.

## Package detail


### `P-01`  Blast doors 1 and 2 — leaves and cast-in frames

**Requirement.** 1200 x 2100, 7 bar, gas-tight, rebound rated. Vendor item; master F.1 records the leaf, frame and anchorage as NOT AVAILABLE.

**Programme.** Enquiry and order at A1110 / A1115; required on site by Frames at A3105 (walls W6/W7); leaves at A5135.

**Note.** THE critical procurement. Frames are a separate, earlier delivery than the leaves so that the wall pour is not held by leaf testing.


### `P-02`  CBRN filter trains AHU-1 and AHU-2

**Requirement.** 300 m³/h each, true N+1. Louvre, blast valve, G4/F7 pre-filter, EN 1822 H14 HEPA, ASZM-TEDA carbon, fan with electric drive AND hand crank.

**Programme.** Enquiry and order at A1130; required on site by A9040.

**Note.** Conflict C21 (250 vs 300 m³/h) MUST be ruled on before the order is placed. Fan static pressure is not derivable — select on DIRTY filter figures, not clean.


### `P-03`  Blast valves, 5 No., and sleeves

**Requirement.** Sizes and sleeve details are on sheet S-06 and are NOT in master Part B.

**Programme.** Enquiry and order at A1140; required on site by A9015 (sleeves cast in) / A9035.

**Note.** Sleeves are needed at the wall and slab pours, well before the valves.


### `P-04`  EMP Zone 2 shielded enclosure

**Requirement.** Welded steel room in bay 3; 80 dB over 10 kHz to 1 GHz; effectiveness verified to IEEE Std 299.

**Programme.** Enquiry and order at A1150; required on site by A11030.

**Note.** Specialist. The reinforcement cage gives 0 dB at 1 GHz, so this is the whole EMP answer, not a supplement to it.


### `P-05`  Generator, 15 kVA

**Requirement.** Bay 8 grey zone; 2600 m³/h combustion and cooling air through BV-4 and BV-5; heat rejection into bay 8 not stated.

**Programme.** Enquiry and order at A1160; required on site by A9050.

**Note.** Delivered before the shafts are closed.


### `P-06`  Armoured vision panels, 8 No.

**Requirement.** 1200 wide, first storey of the sentry post. Specification does not exist in the project.

**Programme.** Enquiry and order at A1165; required on site by A8195.

**Note.** Specification must be issued before the enquiry can be meaningful.


### `P-07`  Submersible pumps and drainage plant

**Requirement.** PU-01/PU-02 1.5 L/s duty and standby with auto-alternation; PU-03 hand pump; PU-04/PU-05 2 L/s for the stairwell sump.

**Programme.** Enquiry and order at A1170; required on site by A10020 / A10035.

**Note.** The hand pump is the third line of defence and is independent of power — it is not an optional extra.


### `P-08`  Reinforcement, Fe500D and Fe500

**Requirement.** 77.3 t including 5 % wastage: 70.46 t for the shelter and entry structures, 1.22 t for the burster slab, 1.97 t for the sentry post. Mill certificates required.

**Programme.** Enquiry and order at A1172; required on site by A3040 (mat, first fixing).

**Note.** Cut and bend to the fabricator's approved bar bending schedule; bend deductions to BS 8666 Table 3 are the fabricator's.


### `P-09`  Waterproofing system

**Requirement.** Continuous external tanking, protection layer, integral crystalline admixture, internal wet-area tanking, waterstops and EMP straps. FN1 leaves the product deliberately open — it specifies performance.

**Programme.** Enquiry and order at A1174; required on site by A3020 (horizontal tanking under the mat).

**Note.** Needed EARLY: the horizontal tanking is the first thing that happens after the blinding.


### `P-10`  SENTRY POST — modular bricks to IS 1077

**Requirement.** Class designation 10, 190 x 90 x 90, about 6 400 No. including 5 % breakage. Sampled to IS 5454 and tested to IS 3495 before order.

**Programme.** Enquiry and order at A1176; required on site by A8135.

**Note.** DESIGN CHANGE SP-B1. Source approved once and not changed without retesting. A single approved batch covers the whole requirement.


### `P-11`  Cement

**Requirement.** About 194 t (3 900 bags): OPC 43 grade to IS 269 or PPC to IS 1489 (Part 1). M35 requires at least 340 kg/m³ and w/c not more than 0.45.

**Programme.** Enquiry and order at With A1050; required on site by A3010 onward.

**Note.** Stacked to IS 4082. Quantity is a LOWER BOUND — the trial mix to IS 10262 fixes the real content.


### `P-12`  Aggregate, coarse and fine

**Requirement.** About 829 t to IS 383, tested to IS 2386. Masonry sand to IS 2116; plaster sand to IS 1542.

**Programme.** Enquiry and order at With A1050; required on site by A3010 onward.

**Note.** Source-tested before first use.


### `P-13`  Formwork and falsework

**Requirement.** About 1 058 m² of contact area; 104 m² of deck at 3.200 m height with props to remain 14 days.

**Programme.** Enquiry and order at With A1060; required on site by A3060 onward.

**Note.** Falsework designed and checked as temporary works to IS 14687.


### `P-14`  Electrical materials and equipment

**Requirement.** Cables, distribution board, luminaires, emergency lighting, earthing conductors and electrodes, EMP penetration protection.

**Programme.** Enquiry and order at Not yet possible; required on site by A11025 onward.

**Note.** *** NO ELECTRICAL DESIGN PACKAGE EXISTS. Quantities are 'to be verified from final measurement' and no enquiry can be issued until the design is produced. ***


### `P-15`  Internal finishes

**Requirement.** Sealed power-floated and seamless coved wet-area floor finishes, coved skirtings, sealed washable wall and soffit coatings, doors and ironmongery.

**Programme.** Enquiry and order at After FN1 product selection; required on site by A12020 onward.

**Note.** FN1 specifies PERFORMANCE, not products. Each product must be approved against its stated requirement before order.


### `P-16`  Drainage materials

**Requirement.** DN100 drains and DN50 rising mains, gullies, chambers, gratings, the gas-tight NRV, blast check valve and deep-seal traps, septic tank and soak pit fill.

**Programme.** Enquiry and order at With A1170; required on site by A10010 onward.

**Note.** Several pipe lengths are NOT DETERMINABLE without a site plan.

| Modular burnt clay bricks | ≈ 6 400 No. | Class designation 10 to **IS 1077**, 190 × 90 × 90. Sampled to **IS 5454**, tested to **IS 3495** for compressive strength, water absorption, efflorescence and warpage | Source approval and testing at `A1176`, 20 days, before order |
| Cement for mortar | 14.5 bags | OPC 43 grade to **IS 269** | With the main cement order |
| Sand for mortar | 3.0 m³ | To **IS 2116** | With the main aggregate order |
| Sand for plaster | With plaster | To **IS 1542** | — |
| Lintel reinforcement and concrete | 0.51 m³ M30 provisional | Design does not yet exist | Must be designed before `A8135` |
| Wall ties to the columns | Not determined | Detail does not exist in the project | Must be designed before `A8135` |

The whole brick requirement is about 6 400 bricks — a single approved batch. That
is an advantage worth protecting: **the source is approved once and is not changed
without retesting**, because a mid-job change of brick source on a 64 m² job means
retesting for a quantity too small to justify it.

---

## Material control on site

* Cement and reinforcement stacked to **IS 4082**; cement off the ground, covered,
  and used in delivery order.
* Bricks stacked clear of the working area, in stacks not exceeding the height that
  IS 4082 recommends, and **thoroughly soaked before laying**.
* Every consignment of reinforcement, cement, aggregate and brick is logged in the
  material test register against its certificate before it is used.
* Aggregate stockpiles kept separate by size and free of contamination from the
  rock crushing operation, which is running on the same site for the cover rubble.

---

## Procurement risks

The four packages with no recovery available once late are the blast doors, the
CBRN filter trains, the blast valves and the EMP enclosure. They are managed by
**monitoring the vendor**, with monthly manufacturing progress reports, rather than
by planning to recover — because there is no recovery to plan.

One package cannot yet be procured at all: **the electrical installation**, because
no electrical design package exists. No enquiry can be issued until the design is
produced, and that date is computed from the programme and issued to the designer
at mobilisation rather than requested when the activity is due to start.
